name: Teen Leadership Program
what_you_do: Teens work with museum guests in the exhibits and labs while getting mentorship and daily learning. It builds career skills and shows how the museum runs.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 18, or at least a rising sophomore. Must attend the initial training and commit to 8 shifts over 16 weeks.
duration: 8 shifts over 16 weeks, every other weekend (Saturday or Sunday)
deadline_text: Spring 2027 applications open Sunday, Nov 8, 2026. They are reviewed Nov 30 to Dec 5, 2026. Students hear back Dec 6, 2026. Close date not posted.
how_to_apply: The page shows no form or link to apply as of Nov 4, 2026. Check back on Nov 8, 2026 or use the Contact Us button on the museum's page. It is hard to get in. They look at writing, drive, growth and teamwork.
notes: The page gives no way to apply yet as of Nov 4, 2026, so the dates are not marked firm. The page prints no year, but the weekdays match 2026 and 2027. Required training is Jan 10, 2027. Shifts run Jan 16 to May 2, 2027.
